meta.promptText: India mein women ke liye online konse brand ke kurta sets kharidun?

response.text:
India mein women ke liye **online kurta sets** kharidne ke liye ye brands kaafi achhe options hain, aur aap apne budget aur style ke hisaab se choose kar sakti hain.[1][2][6][10][11][14][19]

- **Budget-friendly / everyday wear:** **Anayna**, **Aachho**, **Janasya**, **Jaipur Kurti**, **Meesho**.[8][10][11][14][5]
- **Mid-range stylish ethnic wear:** **Libas**, **W for Woman**, **Biba**, **Aurelia**, **Varanga**, **Indya**.[1][2][3][6][9][19]
- **Designer / premium look:** **Ensemble**, **Pernia’s Pop-Up Shop**, **Lakshita**, **Maybell**, **Aachho**.[12][20][7][4][10]

Agar aap **daily office wear** dhoondh rahi hain, to **Libas, Biba, Aurelia, Anayna** achhe options hain kyunki inki collections me straight, cotton, aur comfortable styles milte hain.[1][6][8][9]  
Agar **festive ya party wear** chahiye, to **W for Woman, Aachho, Lakshita, Maybell, Pernia’s Pop-Up Shop** better fit ho sakte hain because these brands highlight embroidered, brocade, georgette, and designer kurta sets.[2][10][7][4][20]

Aap agar chahein, main aapke **budget** ke hisaab se 5 best kurta-set brands shortlist kar doon, jaise:
- **₹1,000–₹2,000**
- **₹2,000–₹5,000**
- **₹5,000+**
